On 10/4/13 5:40 PM, Michael Betancourt wrote:
>> Perhaps we can discuss at the next Stan meeting.
>
> Definitely.

Sounds like fun.

>> I remain curious why we can't try implementing the full auto VB (the version that does not involve dividing the parameters into 2 sets).
>
> The idea is to make this scalable to the canonical "big data" problems were data can only be streamed and not held in memory all at once.

I'd think we'd want two versions of this for Stan.
One "batch" and one "stochastic".

>> Also, if we are dividing the parameters into 2 sets, it would be worth discussing more carefully the difference between your algorithm and my crude "lmer/glmer emulator" idea.
>
> Instead of optimizing the global parameters over the expectation of the local parameters we're hoping to find the variational distribution by taking all expectations. It's just EM vs VB.

Won't stochastic VB give you the same answer as VB
(in principle, anyway)?

- Bob
